confidence_notes: Numbeo's Benidorm page, updated August 2026, gives €15.45 for an inexpensive meal, €45 for a mid-range meal for two, €2.02 for a cappuccino and €3.50 for a 0.5 L local beer. An October 2026 local guide gives wine at €2.50–4 and cocktails at €7–12; those anchors use each range's midpoint. Accommodation evidence is less consistent: a source citing Hotels.com lists 2025 averages of €85 for one-star and €140 for three-star rooms, while a July 2026 report gives €89.90 as Benidorm's average hotel rate across categories. The three-star estimate sits between those figures. Hostelworld shows one Benidorm hostel, dorms from €25, and no private rooms available; the annual dorm and private-room estimates are uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: No proxy city used; Benidorm-specific price sources were available.
